checks.title: A pair is declared in a written contract, never guessed
Records are joined on the shared id, never on a name or an amount
A matched pair produces nothing; a mismatch produces a Difference, never a corrected record
A correction is proposed with both values and written only after a named person accepts it
A record with no partner is an orphan with a reason and an owner, not a silent gap
Rounding and timing tolerances are declared per field with a value, and never assumed
The run publishes on schedule with its counts, including the all-clear
A difference over the declared threshold, or too many mismatches, reaches a named person that run
Every accepted correction keeps both original values and the person who accepted
For any shared id, the runs, differences and corrections are retrievable
